recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for this issue; future edits to the extension definition itself would belong in the FHIR Extension Pack, but the inspected extension-pack source already matches the decision.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO change request raised against STU3 Observation. The event-performerRole extension description used participation examples such as responsible party, author, and verifier, while the example value set was role/title-oriented; the accepted resolution was to keep the description and update the value set to align with it.
initial_application: The Jira comments say the editor pre-applied changes after community review. Git commit 29d523c8173d2ffd355d5606e88092c6917df0f5 explicitly cites GF#13838 and added the active core ValueSet http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/performer-function plus the fhir.ini registration. Commit ce006e8d156e66af655182e3a4e0cfcd4e666e59 later introduced the performerFunction extension source row and bound it extensibly to the same value set.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread confirmed that the intended distinction was function, meaning what the performer did, not the professional role or title they held. Current core no longer carries event-performerRole as an active extension source artifact; the current extension definition lives in the FHIR Extension Pack as event-performerFunction, while core retains the active performer-function value set. FHIR-12638 is nearby role/function background and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active core performer-function value set describes performer involvement and includes ParticipationType concepts for author, verifier, and responsible party, and the current Extension Pack event-performerFunction definition binds to that value set.

related_jiras.note: Related Event Pattern performer-role binding-strength issue already audited on the combined branch; it informs the role/function history but does not require a FHIR-13838 source change.
